business_summary: EC Healthcare provides medical and healthcare services in Hong Kong, Macau, Mainland China, and Taiwan. It operates through three segments: Medical; Aesthetic Medical and Beauty and Wellness; and Veterinary and Other segments. The company offers medical services, including general and family medicine, musculoskeletal health and pain management, eye care, fertility and women's health, men's health, children's health, digestive health, chronic disease management, Chinese medicine, sports medicine, corporate medicine and work rehabilitation, preventive screening and diagnostic imaging, rehabilitation and homecare, and heart and vascular health, oncology and cancer, and allergies and immunology. It also provides aesthetics and antiaging and wellness services; and veterinary, pet care, and lifestyle services. In addition, the company sells skincare products and beauty products; distributes aesthetic devices and beauty related consumables; leases aesthetic devices; provides cancer diagnostic, hair treatment, dental, quasi-medical, traditional beauty, medical surgery, vaccine, hair, chiropractic, and audio engineering solutions and acoustic technology services; and offers cosmetics product. Further, it is involved in property investment; beauty brand management and cosmetic business development; administrative services; medical imaging; provision of management services; scientific instruments and laboratory solutions; biotechnology; integrated life sciences; genomic data solutions; wellness and lifestyle enhancement services; molecular diagnostics; life science research tools; laboratory testing; multi-channel networking services; marketing; and travel agency services. It offers its products and services under the PRODERMA LAB, Swissline, Suissebeaute, and re:HEALTH brands. The company was formerly known as Union Medical Healthcare Limited and changed its name to EC Healthcare in April 2021. EC Healthcare was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: EC Healthcare는 홍콩, 마카오, 중국 본토 및 대만에서 의료 및 의료 서비스를 제공합니다. 그것은 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다: 의료; 미용 의학, 미용 및 웰니스; 수의학 및 기타 부문. 이 회사는 일반 및 가정 의학, 근골격계 건강 및 통증 관리, 안과 치료, 불임 및 여성 건강, 남성 건강, 아동 건강, 소화기 건강, 만성 질환 관리, 한의학, 스포츠 의학, 기업 의학 및 업무 재활, 예방 검진 및 진단 영상, 재활 및 홈케어, 심장 및 혈관 건강, 종양학 및 암, 알레르기 및 면역학을 포함한 의료 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 미용, 노화 방지 및 웰니스 서비스도 제공합니다. 수의학, 애완동물 관리, 라이프스타일 서비스 등이 포함됩니다. 또한 회사는 스킨케어 제품과 미용 제품을 판매합니다. 미용 기기 및 미용 관련 소모품을 유통합니다. 미용 기기를 임대합니다. 암 진단, 헤어 트리트먼트, 치과, 준의료, 전통미용, 의료외과, 백신, 헤어, 카이로프랙틱, 오디오 엔지니어링 솔루션 및 음향 기술 서비스를 제공합니다. 화장품 제품을 제공하고 있습니다.
